title: Hearty Korean Tofu Guk
description: A flavorful and festive Korean dish featuring sake-cooked tofu and yuzu-cured vegetables in a rich guk broth, served in a beautiful lacquerware bowl.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large lacquerware bowl, combine the sake, yuzu juice, and korean chili flakes to make the marinade.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to absorb.
In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic and grated ginger until fragrant.
Add the vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and add it to the pot, letting it cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve the guk hot in the lacquerware bowl, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
